answer: The trellis check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. Answers carry a bond that is slashed when peers grade them as junk, and the bond grows after each offence. Through the anchor, mass-produced answers become mass-produced losses — the farm's thousand submissions each risk a forfeit, while one honest answer risks almost nothing. The terrace does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
